access.ledger_choice: a new Phase 2M-E ledger, separate from the Phase 2M-C one

decomposition.identity: anchor - own digit centre, in pitches = centre error + width error x unit_k - fixed layout pattern - per-record remainder

global_versus_local_anchor_error.question: a wrong slot can be displaced on its own, or sit on a line whose two global degrees of freedom were estimated badly for the whole record

realized_advantage.competitor: the adjacent true digit toward which the anchor is displaced

context_asymmetry.context_policy: 0.16 of the line length on the left, 0.04 on the right

sampling_phase.separation: if a shift helped by moving the line, the gain would follow the shift direction and magnitude; if it helps by changing the sampling phase, the split is between grid-aligned and phase-changing shifts regardless of sign

shift_sweep_reading.note: every shift here is an integer translation, so nothing is interpolated; shifts that are multiples of 4 px leave the phase between the content and the stride-4 feature grid unchanged, and the others change it

card_level_views_and_shift_sweep.sign_test: exact two-sided sign test on the discordant cards only; the unit is the card, so the copies of one card can no longer count as independent evidence

method.attention_pattern: per-slot attention centroid of correctly read cards, fitted to its own uniform grid; it is biased towards zero because the attention is generated by uniform anchors, so it is calibrated on external first
method.ink_pattern: model-free apart from the two global anchors: the ink centroid inside each anchored cell, in pitches from the cell centre, averaged over cards
method.internal_bands: the 664-card internal replay pool, aggregate counts only; these bands come from the frozen broad-band crop, not from digit boxes
method.truth_pattern: external validation only: the annotated digit-box centres, the same statistic section C3 reports

layout_pattern_replication.question: the external archive is fictional, stretched to 640x640 without preserving aspect, and augmented with rotation and shear, so the per-slot layout pattern may be a generator artifact rather than a property of a printed Egyptian card

definition.alignment_only: every wrong position in the record is a shift or a collision
definition.c2_assignment_error: at least one wrong position in the record has its attention argmax nearer a neighbouring true digit centre than its own
definition.glyph_only: every wrong position is a substitution or a neighbour

record_level_fixability.interpretation: an upper bound: it assumes a perfect alignment repair that fixes every record in the class and breaks nothing, which no real change achieves

addendum.status: descriptive measurements added after the primary finding; no threshold changed and the decision is not re-derived from them

c1_mapping.chain: line_rect_from_digit_boxes -> band_quad(context 0.16 left, 0.04 right of line length, band 180x650) -> warp_quad to 180x650 with pad 245 -> phase2l_a.letterbox to 160x576 with pad 245

systematic_versus_per_record.question: is the departure from a uniform grid a fixed printed layout or per-record noise

structure_validity.interpretation: the external identities are fictional and carry intentional semantic inconsistencies, so these are descriptive rates and not correctness tests, and no prediction is ever rewritten or selected with them

target_arithmetic.note: how many units may fail before 99 percent is lost, on each plausible denominator
target_arithmetic.test_denominators_are_structural_only: record and card counts come from the materialized test meta file; no test label, band or prediction was read

claim_2_random_split_leakage.definition: share of records that would have a same-card sibling in train under a random record-level 80/10/10 split; exact expectation under independent assignment

materialization_excluded_records.reason: digit_box_clipped_or_touching_border, the only materialization exclusion reason

archive_audit.scope_note: metadata only; no image, label or prediction was read for this command

conditions_as_declared.ALIGNMENT_DOMINANT: shift + collision positions are at least 50 percent of wrong positions AND more than 50 percent of those shift and collision positions show an assignment error in C2
conditions_as_declared.CARD_CONCENTRATED: at least 50 percent of wrong validation records belong to cards all of whose copies are wrong
conditions_as_declared.GLYPH_DOMINANT: substitution positions are at least 60 percent of wrong positions AND the assignment-error rate over wrong positions is below 50 percent
conditions_as_declared.UNDERFIT: primary exact-sequence rate on the 2673 materialized external-train records, inference mode and no augmentation, is below 0.990
conditions_as_declared.VARIANCE: that train exact rate is at least 0.995 AND the primary validation exact rate is below 0.95

bias_vs_variance.internal_replay_note: aggregate counts only; these are real cards already inside the v2/v3 training pool, so this is a fit measure and not a generalization measure

logits.reject_curve_note: measurement only; no operating point is frozen and no output is selected with truth

readme_audit.declared_split_sizes: neither README states train/valid/test sizes; the sizes are observed from the archive folders and are reported next to the declared image totals
readme_audit.flip_or_mirror_finding: no README declares a flip or mirror augmentation; the token 'flipped' appears as part of one upstream collection name carried by every record identically, so it identifies no subset and cannot be used to split the records
readme_audit.note: paraphrased and extracted by pattern; no README line is reproduced verbatim in any tracked output
